name: fuzz
description: On-demand guidance, cycle-based TDD, ticket delivery and verification, safe Issue closeout, and content generation tools.

interface.shortDescription: Guidance, ticket delivery, closeout, and content generation.
interface.longDescription: Fuzz provides explicit read-only guidance, cycle-based Red to Green collaboration, serial or explicit parallel parent-ticket delivery, fresh-task campaign verification, safe single-Issue closeout, Markdown-to-HTML conversion, bilingual GitHub skills PDFs, Wiki publishing, personal Git weekly reports, and optional imperial-court session conventions.
defaultPrompt: Use $fuzz:one-by-one for one Red to Green cycle at a time.
Use $fuzz:close-issue to verify and safely close one Issue.
Use $fuzz:html to convert Markdown to self-contained HTML.
Use $fuzz:handle-all-tickets <parent ticket> to deliver all child tickets serially by default.
Use $fuzz:verify-all-tickets <parent ticket> in a fresh task for read-only campaign verification.
Use $fuzz:github-skills-pdf to build an English-Chinese skills PDF.
Use $fuzz:generate-wiki to turn source material into a maintainable Wiki.
Use $fuzz:my-weekly to summarize my commits for a natural week.
